title: The channel not jumped
logline: The pup at eight on the flats at a channel he jumped last year, stopped at its edge, looking at the water. The two-one prints end at the edge. The page draws the deciding, and then the going around.

panels.composition: A small three-legged dog stopped at the edge of a tidal channel on the flats looking at the water, its prints ending at the edge, a second trail of prints starting off to the side around the channel's end.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small three-legged dog stopped at the edge of a tidal channel on mudflats looking at the water with its prints ending at the edge and a second trail starting off around the channel's end, no words
